description: Roles that disappeared from a company's own board on or after `since`: filled or taken down. `changed_at` is the day of the scrape that no longer found it, so it is accurate to about a day. Roles are read straight from company career boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever and others) and re-checked daily. Covers engineering jobs at funded startups and AI labs. Show the user the `url` field; `apply_url` is the company's own posting.

since.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 30 days. Default 7 days ago

name: closed_roles
title: Roles that left the board since a date
